representativeTask.title: Run a representative IDE task with pinned Cline through Zeck
representativeTask.description: Run the pinned Cline CLI agent (upstream 252082b9e93b4f91253876391e35b4c13326f5e6) on a representative corpus task (act-mode-edit). Cline operates with Zeck as its sole AI execution authority: every agent-turn model call — act and plan modes, vision attachments, reasoning-effort-controlled turns, and the agentic context-compaction summarizer — becomes a real Zeck execution through the public API; the task result (the implemented function, verified by the corpus check script) and the full Zeck execution trace (lifecycle, route, verification, usage) are exposed.

runBinding.runtime: compat/cline (bun run compat/cline/harness/run-battery.ts composes the pinned Cline runtime, the Zeck adapter, the egress-deny proof environment and the in-process Zeck execution plane)

reproducibility.instructions: From the Zeck repository root: (1) clone and build pinned Cline: git clone https://github.com/cline/cline.git /home/z/my-project/cline-upstream && cd /home/z/my-project/cline-upstream && git checkout 252082b9e93b4f91253876391e35b4c13326f5e6 && bun install && bun -F @cline/shared build && bun -F @cline/llms build && bun -F @cline/agents build && bun -F @cline/core build && bun -F @cline/sdk build; (2) run the battery: bun run compat/cline/harness/run-battery.ts — it composes the Zeck public API in-process, serves the OpenAI-compatible Zeck adapter on a loopback port, runs pinned Cline over the 5-task corpus under the scrubbed environment and the default-deny egress control, and writes deploy/evidence/ppr-019.json with every execution's Zeck trace. The model supply is the sandbox's authorized GLM endpoint (platform-side BYOK material at /etc/.z-ai-config).
reproducibility.integrationRevision: work/PPR-019-cline-proof (see deploy/evidence/ppr-019.json evidenceRecord.pinnedApplication.pin.integrationRevision — the governed Zeck base the integration was built against)
